a card issued for a change, at a civil registration directorate

note: The Treasury's General Communiqué no. 97 on valuable papers (Official Gazette no. 33117, 24 December 2025, in force from 1 January 2026, read 2026-11-03), item 6 of its table: a card issued for a birth registered outside the legal notification period costs 220 lira, one issued for a change 220, one issued after a loss 440. A first card for a birth registered in time isn't in the table, so its fee is null and the player is told; the change is held as the renewal and the loss as the replacement. A late-registered birth's card isn't modelled, and the card's term isn't in the table, so it's null. Capital's report (read 2026-10-28) gave the same fees; until the Gazette was read the game charged 220 for any first card.
